{{Quote|The planet is called Thule. Thousands of years ago, it was a hidden Sith stronghold. Ulic fought there during the war. That's where the Dark Reaper is buried.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|audio=AnakinDiscussesThule.flac|<ref name="TCWVG" />}}
'''Thule''' was a dry and arid [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] steeped in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that lay upon the western flanks of the [[Stygian Caldera]] in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]. A hidden [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] for most of its history, Thule consistently served as a redoubt and resource for many generations of Sith over a protracted period of millennia.

Originally a part of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]], Thule was colonized by members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] prior to the formation of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]] in [[6900 BBY]]. A fortified stronghold of the early Sith, Thule eventually came to host a [[Sith stealth regiment]] drawn to the world for its power in the dark side and its remote location. The planet's isolation allowed it to survive the Empire's fall in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], and its [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] units were subsequently joined by Sith-blooded refugees fleeing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] of the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] at the war's end. The world became a hidden stronghold of both [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Exar Kun's]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Revan's Sith Empires]], and its residents swore themselves in service to the Sith Order in its disparate incarnations over the subsequent millennia.

Thule was unique in that its population was aware of the Sith's continued existence following the [[Ruusan campaign|conclusion]] of the [[New Sith Wars]], in which the last vestiges of the Sith were widely assumed to have been rendered extinct. Pledged in service to the surviving [[Rule of Two/Legends|Banite Sith]] of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]], Thule's elite soldiers frequently participated in the schemes of various [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith masters]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] and into the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. Thule's status as a hidden resource world for the Sith Order's use alone, confirmed with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] deletion of Thule from both the histories and [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]], ultimately allowed it to survive the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] fragmentation and persist in isolation through the conflicts and crises that followed the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Description==
[[File:Thurra_system_map.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A map of the Thurra system]]
Thule was the innermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TCSWE241" /> of the [[Thurra system/Legends|Thurra system]],<ref name="GatORW" /> a remote [[Star system/Legends|star system]] situated upon the western flanks of the [[Stygian Caldera]] in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> Thule shared its [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Thurra]] with the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Enenpa]], and was itself orbited by [[Sivvi]], a captured [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]<ref name="GatORW" /> which served as Thule's sole natural satellite.<ref name="TCSWE241" /> Thule rotated on its axis every thirty-eight [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and orbited Thurra every four hundred and fifty-nine [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] on average.<ref name="GatORW" />

Thule was a dry and arid terrestrial world<ref name="TCSWE241" /> possessed of a [[Atmosphere/Legends#Type I atmospheres|Type I atmosphere]] and [[Gravity/Legends|standard gravity]]. Apart from a few arable regions that hosted the bulk of the planet's [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Farm/Legends|farms]], Thule's surface was barren and covered with a thick carpet of charred gray rock and fine sand.<ref name="GatORW" /> Its landscape was primarily characterized by blackened hills, rich savannas,<ref name="TCSWE241" /> rocky plains, and wind-hollowed canyons punctuated at length by tall, natural spires. Despite heavy cloud cover that birthed both frequent windstorms<ref name="GatORW" /> and protracted bouts of colored lightning,<ref name="TCSWE241" /> Thule experienced fewer than fifty days of rain per year.<ref name="GatORW" />

Though Thule was believed to have once been home to a variety of indigenous lifeforms during its earliest history,<ref name="TCSWE241" /> most of this endemic flora and fauna was ultimately rendered extinct by the subsequent colonization efforts of the planet's inhabitants<ref name="GatORW" /> and by the ferocity of its weather patterns. Only a unique [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bioluminescence/Legends|bioluminescent]] [[Moss/Legends|moss]] that fed on the planet's charred rock content and lit Thule's stony outcroppings<ref name="TCSWE241" /> and spires<ref name="GatORW" /> with an eerie light managed to persist unmolested on the planet's surface.<ref name="TCSWE241" />

==History==
===Xim's empire===
Sometime between [[25,127 BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]], Thule was enfolded into [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]] following the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord's]] successful conquests of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]]. Thule marked the northernmost extremity of the empire's reach at the height of its territorial expansion and guarded the border close at hand to the [[Radama Void/Legends|Radama Void]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Sith Empire===
[[File:SithTempleOnThule.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Hurom]] and [[Sith temple (Hurom)|its Sith Temple]]]]
Prior to the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] to Korriban in [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Thule was colonized by members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] during their period of outward expansion from the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]]. As recorded by ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] in [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|her 6900 BBY chronicle]], Thule served the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|ancient Sith Empire]] and the reorganized [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]] as a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] "fortified against counterattack from any foe."<ref name="BoS" /> By the time of the [[Golden Age of the Sith]] nearly two millennia later,<ref name="TDSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> the planet had come to host a [[Sith stealth regiment]] drawn to the world by its strong connection to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and its isolated location.<ref name="GatORW" />

During the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Thule was the site at which the Sith [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[Dark Reaper]] was constructed and stored during its period of assembly.<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> One of the hangars in Thule's expansive [[Armory (Thule)|armory complex]], located some forty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] outside the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Hurom]], was used to house the superweapon prior to its initial usage against the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="GatORW" /> It remained on the planet prior to its subsequent rediscovery by [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Brotherhood of the Sith]] a millennium later.<ref name="KOTORCG" /><ref name="TCSWE168">{{CSWECite|I|168|Dark Reaper}}</ref>

Following the Sith Empire's defeat in the Great Hyperspace War,<ref name="GH27">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 27: The Great Hyperspace War}}</ref> a small number of Sith refugees<ref name="TEA" /> and loyalists<ref name="GatORW" /> fled to Thule in an effort to escape the [[post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion]], a joint [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]&ndash;Republic invasion of the Sith Empire<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> aimed at eliminating any vestigial threat it posed to the safety of the Republic.<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="GH30">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 30: Rise of the Sith Emperor}}</ref> Confident that the Empire's defeat at the hands of the Republic would be temporary, the regiment remained in seclusion on Thule for centuries, bolstering its ranks with Sith loyalists and training in preparation to serve as a vanguard force for a resurgent Sith Empire.<ref name="GatORW" />

===Post–Great Hyperspace War===
{{Main|Battle of Thule (Great Sith War)}}
{{Quote|The evil is in ''you'', Darth Bane&mdash;as it should be. If you went to the shining towers of Cinnagar, or the plush chambers of Coruscant, or the rich savannas of Thule, the evil would still be within you.|[[Skere Kaan]]|<ref name="BotS">{{GamerCite|3|Bane of the Sith}}</ref>}}
During the height of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], Thule served as a stronghold and forward base of operations for members of Exar Kun's Brotherhood of the Sith and associated [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Dark Reaper campaign]] of the [[Krath Holy Crusade]],<ref name="TEA" /> Thule was invaded and conquered in the [[Battle of Thule (Great Sith War)|Battle of Thule]] by a task force of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] led to the planet by redeemed Jedi and former Sith Lord [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]].<ref name="TCWVG" /> This force subsequently dismantled and entombed the Sith Dark Reaper superweapon beneath the planet's surface,<ref name="TCSWE241" /> where it remained hidden in the darkness and lost to subsequent generations of Sith for nearly four millennia.<ref name="TCSWE168" /> Despite their defeat, Sith survivors persisted on Thule through the passage of the centuries, maintaining ties to other vestigial groups of Sith loyalists.<ref name="GatORW" />

Though their numbers sank significantly in the years that followed until the planet's population numbered fewer than a million residents in total, the descendants of the original Sith continued to pledge themselves to the service of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] in their varied iterations and incarnations.<ref name="GatORW" /> During the [[Light and Darkness War]], around the time of the [[Ruusan campaign]], agents of [[Skere Kaan]]'s [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] found their way into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and encountered the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The legion of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] that accompanied Kaan's agents back to the [[New Sith]] Empire settled Thule and ultimately bolstered the planet's faltering population.<ref name="TUR" /> With [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] implementation of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] following the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], Thule's elite soldiers swore themselves in service to the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] and frequently participated in the schemes of [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith masters]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="GatORW" /><ref name="TCSWE241" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Main|Battle of Thule}}
Roughly a century prior to the rise of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Sith [[Priest/Legends|priests]] in residence at Thule's [[Sith temple (Hurom)|Sith Temple]] began receiving both dark-sided visions of millions of soldiers descending upon Thule to restore the Sith to power and prophesies reaffirming Thule's exulted place in the new order to come. Just prior to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], these prophesies were seemingly fulfilled. Millions of soldiers in the employ of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] were deployed to Thule on the orders of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and began restoring the disassembled Dark Reaper for use against the Republic. Thule was abuzz with activity during this period,<ref name="GatORW" /> which saw the construction of a host of support structures in the vicinity of [[Kesiak]] ranging from a [[Command Installation]] to multiple [[Thule droid factory/Legends|droid factories]].<ref name="TCWVG" />

[[File:Ruins_of_Kessia.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The city of [[Kesiak]] was reduced to ruins during the [[Battle of Thule]]]]
However, Dooku's plans for the Dark Reaper never came to fruition. A Republic task force under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] brought about an end to the ongoing [[Dark Reaper crisis]] with an invasion of Thule that saw the final dismantling and destruction of the Dark Reaper. Though the Republic withdrew soon thereafter to the [[Mirgoshir system/Legends|Mirgoshir system]],<ref name="TCWVG" /> the inhabitants of Thule remained demoralized from their defeat. The planet continued to see limited usage by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a staging ground for other Separatist forces until the end of the war, but never managed to enjoy the glory or significance its priests' prophesies had previously promised.<ref name="GatORW" />

===Imperial Period===
With the Declaration of a New Order and rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Thule once again came to serve as a resource world and redoubt for the Sith. Soon after his ascent, Emperor Palpatine scrubbed all record of Thule from the Imperial records, documented histories,<ref name="GatORW" /> and navigational databases,<ref name="TCSWE241" /> to reserve the exclusive use of its elite soldiers for the Sith rather than the greater Empire.<ref name="GatORW" /><ref name="TCSWE241" /> This fact allowed Thule to survive his death and navigate the subsequent fragmentation of the Empire that followed the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The planet remained hidden from the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in the decades that followed on account of its isolation and its leaders' policy of noninterference in the politics of the outside galaxy.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|And the worlds of Malachor and Thule were fortified against counterattack from any foe. They will serve as the perfect positions from which to launch our reconquest of the Republic.|''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] describes Thule in [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|her 6900 BBY chronicle]]|<ref name="BoS" />}}
Unlike most Outer Rim worlds, Thule consistently boasted a uncommonly large [[Human/Legends|Human]] population over the course of its history.<ref name="GatORW" /> Those residents not of direct Human ancestry were often members of [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] like the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]], Chiss,<ref name="TUR" /> and [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]], and a multiplicity of uncatalogued near-Human offshoot [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] unknown to most contemporary [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] likewise maintained a presence on Thule during the Old Republic period. Though [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] saw frequent use, the ancient [[Sith (language)|Sith language]] was commonly spoken by certain segments of the population, a vestige of the legacy established by the [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] Sith species who constituted Thule's earliest inhabitants.<ref name="GatORW" />

Thule's culture was decidedly martial in nature, with professional soldiers, mercenaries, and militia constituting the bulk of the planet's population. The open carrying of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], and [[Power armor/Legends|power armor]] on the streets of the planet's major cities was a common sight, and military uniforms of every type and variety were considered "normal" everyday dress. Though residential areas housing families and noncombat personnel could be found in Thule's cities, no citizens were permitted to be civilians. All residents, even those not directly involved with the military, were expected to contribute to the defense of the planet during wartime, and even shopkeepers were familiar with the use of weaponry ranging from [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] to [[Anti-aircraft gun|static defense points]]. In the capital of Hurom, all able-bodied adults were required to own blasters and participate in bimonthly training sessions aimed at keeping their skills honed, regardless of their affiliation with respect to the military.<ref name="GatORW" />

In accordance with its overtly militaristic society, Thule was governed by a variety of dark-sided military juntas and dictatorships over the course of its history. By the time of the Clone Wars, the planet was ruled by a strict military hierarchy led by a single ranking [[General/Legends|general]] and a wide military staff. The general was expected to remain in constant consultation with the Sith priests in residence at the planet's Sith Temple located in Hurom. As such, the planetary government was likewise nominally housed in Hurom, though its leadership was often just as likely to rule the planet offworld as on.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Locations==
===Hurom===
{{Main|Hurom}}
Due to the general inhospitality of Thule's environment, the vast majority of the world's population lived in or around several dozen settlements that dotted the planet's surface and rarely ventured far from the major metropolitan areas into the wilderness. The capital city of Hurom was the largest of Thule's settlements with a population of twenty million and housed the many of the oldest and most significant structures on the planet. In accordance with Thule's overtly martial culture, Hurom's construction, layout, and architecture were all singularly designed to repel external assault and siege. Its straight, wide streets and large open plazas were populated with [[anti-personnel laser cannon]]s capable of repulsing ground forces, while [[Anti-aircraft cannon/Legends|anti-aircraft cannons]] laid out across the city in a grid provided comprehensive cover from aerial assaults. Many of Hurom's buildings extended deep underground, connected to each other via subterranean tunnels and shelters.<ref name="GatORW" />

===Kesiak===
{{Main|Kesiak}}
The major city of Kesiak was a Sith stronghold of the Brotherhood of the Sith during the Dark Reaper campaign of the Krath Holy Crusade and Great Sith War. Following the invasion of Thule by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force during the Battle of Thule, the city's [[Sith temple (Kesiak)|Sith Temple]] served as the burial place of the Dark Reaper,<ref name="TCWVG" /> a Sith superweapon dismantled by the Jedi and entombed on Thule in perpetuity.<ref name="TCSWE168" /> The weapon was eventually rediscovered and reassembled by Count Dooku during the lead-up to the start of the Clone Wars, though both the weapon and the city under which it had been hidden for nearly four millennia were destroyed during the subsequent Republic invasion of Thule at the height of the Dark Reaper crisis.<ref name="TCWVG" />

===Armory===
{{Main|Armory (Thule)}}
One of Thule's more noteworthy structures was an expansive armory complex that lay some forty kilometers outside the capital city of Hurom. This complex contained facilities ranging from weapons caches housing racks of blaster rifles and [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistols]] of every model to archives in which plans for Sith superweapons and vehicles were catalogued. One particularly fortified facility near the center of the complex was used exclusively to store [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]], [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]], and other components employed in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction,<ref name="GatORW" /> and one of the complex's hangars was the location at which the ancient Dark Reaper superweapon of the old Sith Empire was assembled during the Great Hyperspace War.<ref name="KOTORCG" />

===Hurom's Sith Temple===
{{Main|Sith temple (Hurom)}}
Like many Sith-dominated worlds, Thule was home to a number of Sith Temples. Its capital of Hurom hosted an imposing Sith Temple of its own that served as the meeting place for government officials and the planet's population of dark-sided Sith priests. Situated in the heart of downtown Hurom, the Temple dominated the cityscape and covered over a full block of the city center. It was from here that Sith priests first received their visions of millions of soldiers descending upon Thule to restore the Sith to power roughly a century prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="GatORW" />

===Kesiak's Sith Temple===
{{Main|Sith temple (Kesiak)}}
The city of Kesiak likewise hosted its own Sith Temple around the time of the Clone Wars and the Dark Reaper crisis. It was here that the forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Techno Union, under orders from Count Dooku, attempted to restore and reactivate the Dark Reaper, an ancient Sith superweapon built at Thule's armory and stored in Kesiak. During the Battle of Thule, Anakin Skywalker managed to fight his way through to the Kesiak Sith Temple precinct and destroy the Dark Reaper using a [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]].<ref name="TCWVG" />

===Sith Arts Academy===
{{Main|Sith Arts Academy}}
At some point in the course of its history, Thule established and hosted a Sith Arts Academy dedicated to the training of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] in the dark side of the Force. Around the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the institution's headmistress was a fallen [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] by the name of [[Drevveka Hoctu]] whose methods of instruction included protracted survivalist exercises and deprivation training in Thule's barren back country for the purposes of establishing her students' reliance on the dark side of the Force for sustenance.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] places Thule in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], in relative proximity to [[Shili/Legends|Shili]], whereas other sources confirm its location in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Due to a last minute change at Lucas Licensing, Thule was also incorrectly placed in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''.<ref name="GMD">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=118855&start=60#4037723|thread=Galaxy Map Discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2003-06-03|time=9:43 AM|quote=I just wanted to point out that, due to a last minute change, the position of Thule in Inside the Worlds of Attack of the Clones in the Inner Rim is incorrect. It should be located in the Outer Rim as described in the Clone Wars videogame.}}</ref> Furthermore, sources differ as to which named major city constitutes the planet's capital. The 2002 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]] referred to [[Kesiak]] as the planet's capital, while the 2004 sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' stated Thule's capital during the Clone Wars to be [[Hurom]].
